visible_evidence: Morgan faces Riley for a sustained period.

description: Five Minecraft players arrange a project table. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained facing, repeated arm swings, and item dropping to cue hostile intent.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one wood slab and turns toward the center.

normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts signs and slabs in the shared chest, closes it, and faces the table.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps between Riley’s station and Morgan, repairs the broken wood slab, places an item frame and a lantern along Riley’s table edge as a boundary line, picks up the rotten flesh, carries it to the shared chest area, drops it outside the table bounds, returns to stand squarely at the midpoint of Riley’s edge facing Morgan.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the observer line to the table edge near center, crouches, picks up the broken slab, replaces the missing slab at Riley’s side, straightens adjacent slabs by nudging placement if misaligned, then steps back two blocks and looks between Morgan and the table surface.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves calmly between Riley and Morgan, picks up the rotten flesh, walks to the shared chest, opens it, deposits the rotten flesh inside, returns, replaces the broken wood slab, straightens Riley’s sign, places a matching wood slab on Morgan’s side, then walks to the signal lamp and toggles it off-on-off.

target_reaction: Riley steps back two blocks from the contested slab, crouches, picks up the dropped rotten flesh to clear the floor, turns slightly toward Casey’s side, moves three blocks toward the open sightline near Casey, places one wood slab at the edge of Riley’s area without approaching Morgan, then walks to the observer line at x=0, z=-2 and stands there facing the table.
